ratings.reason: The diff does not touch schedule location; run.py still resolves shared schedules via find_schedule, so the superseded status is unchanged.
export.py/run.py still write model/observe/<run>.jsonl with side model; no change.
Diff adds Lifetime as L in ticks and off/early/ClockStep, so time is no longer only an abstract reported value.
Pause/Resume and Good(c) still treat paused clients as not up; no run-time clock enforcement added.
Elect now uses MajOf(Q, X.mem) over the adopted configuration and allows early[n] instead of only ~HearsLeader(n), contradicting any-majority and only-when-no-leader.
DoRequest still requires ~pending[c], so a waiting client does not send another request.
Grant/Resend still record at issuance and retransmit the same token; v3 adds config_epoch and recorded inputs to the grant record.
Emit now carries a sequence of events and Matches scans it, preserving T1 while covering multi-event steps.
Quiescent is extended with rcMsgs, NoPending, owed and opMsgs, so end-of-run now covers reconfiguration.
Resolve still resolves grantor/holder at trigger time; non-member is added separately.
StaleTok is unchanged in the diff.
compile.py now accepts 1-6 lease nodes, operators/config and F3.x actions, contradicting fixed 3/2/1 and F1.1-F1.3-only.
Already contradicted by X2; the diff keeps per-send link fate and does not alter that status.
Ordinary Crash/Restart still keep durable promised/maxTok and storage ledger; diff adds operator exclusion and amnesia as separate F3.3.
C1_2 remains over the decisions history; StorageDecide only adds stored_value input.
RecvAck/WriteAck still identify by client/token/value and record accepted only from the ack outcome.
Good(c) now requires NoPending and an eligible majority of GLatest, not any majority of lease nodes.
C1_4 still reads pending[c] => <>~pending[c]; crash still ends waiting.
Witness export still produces one shortest trace per PASS run.
export.py changes identity to (proc, inc, seq) with seq restarting per incarnation, contradicting per-process seq.
P3/P7 mutation breaks remain as described in the diff.
Emit/ScheduleStep still arm the next trigger on lastEv' and now scan a sequence, so an action's own emitted events can trigger the next step.
Quiescent still counts messages only to running receivers; the diff extends the same rule to reconfig messages and owed replies.
Resolve still resolves at trigger time; the diff adds non-member resolution with the same wait-if-unresolved behaviour.
static_checks remains conservative and now also handles reconfig/amnesia aliases.
Join(n) still brings lagging nodes into the leader's term, now over JoinScope in one step.
trigNG/trigNM are updated after lastEv' in Emit/ScheduleStep, preserving just-after-trigger evaluation.
NGChoices still returns trigNG; if empty, ScheduleStep has no ng and waits.
DoRead still sets rid |-> pc.
C2_1 still checks read tokens against accepted write history, not the ledger variable.
StorageRead still leaves highest unchanged on every read decision.
StorageRead still records held as stval at decision and returns it.
ReadReject and rejected ReadAck still carry no value.
Duplicate read acks are still ignored because only awaited reads are acked.
DoRead/RecvReadAck do not alter tok or pending grant state.
P13-P18 mutation texts are re-applied with only kvars/xvars frames; breaks unchanged.
export.py still sets answers from the client's attempt and leaves causes empty when no storage decision exists.
Directional HearsLeader/Link definitions remain; the diff adds early as an additional timer trigger.
Elect now allows early[q] voters, so a node may vote while hearing a leader, contradicting stickiness.
CheckQuorum still steps down when not connected to a majority, now of eligible current configuration and also on removal/early.
Already contradicted by the routing fix; Grant still uses ReqRoute/RepRoute rather than Conn.
Already contradicted; ReqRoute/RepRoute relay remains.
NGChoices/Resolve still resolve all non-grantor occurrences to one explored node.
export.py still emits cut/drop pairs and directed links.
ReqRoute/RepRoute one-hop lease-node relay remains; FwdRoute extends the same route to reconfig forwarding.
Grant still records when heard, issued prevents same-term re-grant, Resend retransmits; v3 adds config_epoch and inputs.
